[USER] User expressed interest in common spices used in Indian cuisine and their incorporation into dishes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Common spices in Indian cuisine include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Turmeric - used to add color and flavor to curries, rice dishes, and chutneys.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Cumin - used in roasted form for earthy flavor and ground form for nutty taste in curries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Coriander - ground seeds used in spice blends, leaves used as garnish for curries and chutneys.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Cardamom - used in sweets, desserts, biryanis, curries, and tea.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Mustard seeds - used for tempering, adds a pungent flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Fenugreek - used in curries, lentil dishes, and chutneys, has medicinal properties.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Garam Masala - a blend of spices including cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, and cumin, added to biryanis, curries, and soups.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Spices are incorporated in various ways: some added at the beginning of cooking, others used for tempering at the end, some as garnish, and others in spice blends.  
[USER] User expressed interest in recipe recommendations using these spices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recipe recommendations include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Chicken Tikka Masala - features chicken marinated in yoghurt and spices like turmeric and cumin, in a creamy tomato sauce with garam masala and fenugreek.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Vegetable Korma - a medley of vegetables in a coconut milk-based sauce flavored with cardamom and coriander.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Dal Makhani - black lentils cooked with cumin and coriander, finished with cream.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Aloo Gobi - potatoes and cauliflower cooked with cumin, turmeric, and ground coriander.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Chai Tea - black tea with spices like cardamom, cinnamon, and star anise, sweetened with milk and sugar.
